recognize_zh: 這是 FISH 與染色體圖而非形態：間期細胞核內出現大量散布或成團的 MYC 訊號（像煙火一樣），分裂中期也見到許多散在的訊號、倒相 DAPI 核型可見大量雙微體（double minutes），代表 MYC 基因擴增，常見於骨髓發育不良相關 AML。
features: Interphase FISH: many nuclei with numerous amplified probe signals, clustered or scattered throughout the nucleus ('fireworks')
Some nuclei show only a few normal signals (non-amplified cells)
Metaphase FISH: many small signals scattered around and between chromosomes, consistent with extrachromosomal amplification
Inverted DAPI/G-banded metaphase shows numerous tiny paired chromatin bodies (double minutes)
describe_en: Interphase FISH with a MYC probe shows a large proportion of nuclei with innumerable amplified signals, either clustered or dispersed, alongside occasional nuclei with a normal signal pattern. Metaphase FISH demonstrates numerous small signals scattered among the chromosomes rather than confined to a single chromosomal locus, and the corresponding banded metaphase shows multiple double minute chromosomes. Findings indicate high-level MYC amplification in the form of double minutes, a rare adverse-risk finding typically seen in AML with myelodysplasia-related changes and complex karyotype.

ddx.dx: MYC amplification as homogeneously staining region (hsr)
ddx.vs: In an hsr the amplified signals are clustered on one marker chromosome at metaphase rather than scattered as double minutes.
A break-apart pattern shows split red and green signals without increased copy number, unlike the many signals seen here.
Trisomy 8 yields three discrete MYC signals per nucleus, not dozens.
